title: Bag of bricks- Olive Green 17
descriptionHtml:
Olive Green — colour 17

A muted, earthy green with a brown undertone. Olive suits military themes, dry landscapes and camouflage patterns, and calms down a design that has too much bright green in it.

Works well with: Jungle Green 16, Brown 12, Sand 03

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Olive Green bricks (colour 17) for Memobrick mosaics. A muted earthy green for military themes, landscapes and natural texture.
